transkript.t: This free GitHub project turns cloud code into a full game studio with 49 AI agents
that work together like a real team.
Right now, if you build something alone with AI, nobody checks your work.
Nobody asks if it fits your vision.
This project fixes that by organizing the agents the way an actual studio is organized.
At the top are directors who protect the creative vision and the tech.
Below them are leads who own design, art, audio, narrative and Q&A.
Under them are specialists who do the hands-on building.
Each agent has its own job, knows who to escalate to and has quality checks it has to pass.
You get more than 70 commands that cover everything,
from brainstorming the idea to writing the release checklist.
Nothing gets written without your approval, so you still make every call.
But now you have a team asking the right questions.
So more process doesn't make a better product.
It's called Cloud Code Game Studios.
